(define rle
  (lambda (str)
    (let loop ((chars (string->list str))
               (count 0)
               (char #\space)
               (result '()))
      (if (null? chars)
          (reverse (cons (list count char) result))
          (let* ((c (car chars))
                 (rest (cdr chars)))
            (if (eqv? c char)
                (loop rest (+ 1 count) char result)
                (loop rest 1 c (cons (list count char) result))))))))
